title_zh: 多米诺 · 夹住中间骨牌
scope_en: A recorded physical operation checked against an existing frozen six-node graph and encoder. Descendant highlights are not fresh graph learning or fitted predictions.

timing: Phase-based speed changes; labels describe recorded replay speed. Reading pauses remain.
